about: NIP-CK v4 reader vectors (big items, sub-items, notes). Every checklist reader loads this file and must produce `expect` for each case: per item id its `role` (plain|big|sub); a big item's `state`, `started_at` and `trip` (whether `add --parent` under it is refused); a sub-item's accepted `notes` (event ids, oldest first). The owner's reactions are among the events. Regenerate with NIP-CK-v4-vectors.js; never hand-edit.

cases.name: flat_list_unchanged
cases.why: no parent anywhere: every item is plain, as before v4

cases.name: big_open
cases.why: a sub-item is open; started_at is the first sub-item start

cases.name: big_waiting_on_simplicity
cases.why: every sub-item done, no simplicity pass yet

cases.name: big_simple_before_last_tick
cases.why: a tick after simple_at puts the big item back to waiting

cases.name: big_done
cases.why: simple_at at or after the last tick: done, whatever the big item status says

cases.name: big_status_field_ignored
cases.why: a big item written as done with an open sub-item is open

cases.name: proposed_no_thumb
cases.why: request set; reactions from others, or another emoji from the owner, do not approve

cases.name: notes
cases.why: driver and owner notes on a sub-item, oldest first; others, notes on a big item and another channel are ignored

cases.name: trip
cases.why: three added after the start outnumber the two it started with

cases.name: trip_reset_by_replan
cases.why: only sub-items added after the re-plan count
